[[Celestic Town]] }} '''Maddening Magby''' (Japanese: '''VS ブビィ''' ''VS Magby''), titled '''VS Magby''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 384th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 47th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}. It is subtitled '''The Furnace and the Moving Floor''' (Japanese: '''タタラと動く床''' ''Tatara and Moving Tiles'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Fuego and Moving Tiles''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} When {{adv|Pearl}} turns around he sees a familiar face, the same {{p|Luxray}} that he met several weeks ago on {{rt|203|Sinnoh}}. They greet each other before trying to get into the building. After attempting to enter through the doors that are locked, Luxray leads Pearl to a hole nearby that they can use to get in, Luxray then decides to have Pearl follow him. Once inside, Pearl accidentally steps on some transfer belts and crashes against a barrel and a wall. Luxray's eyes turn gold, scanning for [[Mr. Fuego|the person]] who was calling for help and after a few seconds it spots him. They run into a weak Mr. Fuego, who introduces himself and explains how he got trapped in there after a quarrel with [[Team Galactic]], which started because he discovered that he was being used to build a bomb. Mr. Fuego then warns that they are not alone. Team Galactic have left many {{p|Magby}} locked inside with them. The Magby attack the group at once, as [[Chimler]] and [[Chatler]] retaliate with {{m|Focus Punch}}, {{m|Pluck}}, {{m|Close Combat}}, and {{m|Mirror Move}}, defeating the Magby army swiftly. Pearl says he'd get ahead, but suddenly steps onto another transfer belt, although this time the final stop is the burning furnace. Meanwhile in [[Celestic Town]], [[Cynthia]] and her [[Cynthia's grandmother|grandmother]] are discussing [[Cyrus]]'s recent attack, and its link to a scripture found in the cave inside the town. Cynthia then tells her grandmother to hand her the scripture, promising she'll take care of it by any means necessary. ==Major events== * {{adv|Pearl}} is reunited with the [[Rayler|Luxray]] he had met [[PS349|several weeks ago]]. * Pearl rescues [[Mr. Fuego]] and his {{p|Shellos}} from a bricked up wall. * Pearl suddenly steps on the transfer belt heading straight to the blast furnace. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== * [[Mr. Fuego]] ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Wormadam}} ({{form|Wormadam|Sandy Cloak}}) ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Diamond}} (flashback) * {{adv|Pearl}} * {{adv|Platinum}} (flashback) * [[Cynthia]] * [[Cynthia's grandmother]] * [[Mr. Fuego]] * Guards ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Chatot}} ([[Chatler]]/{{tt|Chahiko|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Pearl}}'s) * {{p|Monferno}} ([[Chimler]]/{{tt|Chimhiko|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Pearl}}'s; flashback) * {{p|Infernape}} ([[Chimler]]/{{tt|Chimhiko|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Pearl}}'s) * {{p|Ponyta}} ({{OP|Platinum|Ponyta}}; flashback) * {{p|Prinplup}} ({{OP|Platinum|Prinplup}}; flashback) * {{p|Garchomp}} ({{OP|Cynthia|Garchomp}}) * {{p|Shellos}} ([[Mr. Fuego]]'s; East Sea) * {{p|Wormadam}} (Guard's; {{form|Wormadam|Sandy Cloak}}; debut) * {{p|Hoothoot}} (Guard's) * {{p|Luxray}} ([[Rayler|Adventures]]) * {{p|Magby}} ({{tc|Team Galactic Grunt}}s'; multiple) * {{p|Shinx}} (multiple) * {{p|Luxio}} (multiple) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== * In the [[VIZ Media]] version, {{adv|Pearl}} states that he first met {{p|Luxray}} on Route 233 instead of {{rt|203|Sinnoh}}. ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color=FFCCCC|bordercolor=9999FF |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 小鴨嘴龍|VS Magby}} (Taiwan)
